name: Vol-expansion breakout — realized breaks out of compression (1d)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: the realized-vol-only expansion-momentum edge — the ECONOMIC COMPLEMENT to the low-vol tilt and calm-window reversion in this family. Volatility clusters: a period of compressed realized vol that then EXPANDS with an up-move is the start of a new trending regime (the coiled spring finally releasing on the daily grid, where the compression is a genuine multi-week base rather than intraday noise). We ride the expansion WITH price momentum so we take the confirmed breakout, not a fakeout. Entry (long): vol_realized crosses UP through a fitted floor (realized is expanding out of compression) AND ret_Nd positive (the expansion is to the upside) AND bb_width above a fitted floor (bands are widening, confirming the regime shift, not a single-bar spike). The counterparty is the range-bound mean-reversion crowd that keeps fading the base and is now offside as the range breaks. Realized features only (no DVOL) -> dodges the 148-point data wall. Exit: vol_realized crosses down through a fitted level (expansion fading -> the trend regime is ending) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain daily momentum long (drop the vol_realized cross-up) matches the deflated Sharpe, the expansion trigger adds no timing edge and this is plain trend-following. DISCONFIRMER 2: if this expansion-breakout AND the low-vol-anomaly tilt (hh-volatility-08) both clear on the same symbols, they are trading opposite signs of the same feature and one is spurious -> the vol regime is not selecting. DISCONFIRMER 3: net of fees vs buy-and-hold BTC, the breakout must beat B&H or it's disguised beta.
catalyst: realized vol expanding out of a compressed base with upside momentum
